lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance white spots arranged in a non-linear grid posterior to the cranial region, transitioning from high-density, small-diameter spots anteriorly to larger, more isolated circular clusters mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity visible connecting several of the larger circular blobs, creating a loose grid-like structure along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features visible on the upper dorsal-lateral surface, exhibiting a sharp transition from light intensity on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density micro-spotting visible on the cranial region, transitioning into more elongated, worm-like patterning just above the pectoral fin insertion point.
